analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price($135.44) vs SMA5($149.79)/SMA20($165.46)/SMA50($174.42): Below, confirming short-term and mid-term bearish trend.
· Position vs SMA100($179.24)/SMA200($159.09): Below, maintaining long-term bearish trend strength.
· 52-week Position (0.7%) + Current price approaching 52-week low($131.82), nearing historical low zone.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (46.6→27.2): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.3621→-2.7491): Worsening, signaling continuation of bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $141.75): Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($108.92): 52-week low($131.82) may act as a short-term support.
· Swing Resistance ($174.64): Significant distance from current price, expecting difficulty in short-term breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Forming Lower Low): Confirming continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.88x): Contracting volume, potential for slowdown in decline but weak signal for trend reversal.
· Current Zone Diagnosis (Downtrend): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to oversold RSI and proximity to 52-week low. Consider buying near 52-week low on further declines.
